The Arab Kings.

And while the lord of Sinjar was prepared to surrender it,
and to accept an exchange for it, he took courage and held out.
And the ambassador of the Caliph al-Nasir came to al-Adil and reproached him;
and peace was made between them, on the condition that the places he had taken should remain his,
namely Khabur and Nisibis;
and he departed and went to Syria.
At this time, while Muzaffar al-Din, the lord of Erbil, was in Mosul,
he gave both of his daughters to the two sons of Nur al-Din:
Izz al-Din Mas'ud and Imad al-Din Zangi.
Now this Muzaffar al-Din was a great helper to the house of al-Adil.
However, because the lord of Sinjar sent his son to him and pleaded with him to intercede for him with al-Adil,
so that he might leave Sinjar to him,
and when Muzaffar al-Din sent with confidence to al-Adil,
thinking that even if he asked for half of his realm,
he would not turn back his request empty,
yet when al-Adil disregarded his petition,
he took offense at him,
and he sided with Nur al-Din, after the great hatred that had existed between them.
In this year died Fakhr al-Din al-Razi, at the age of sixty-three lunar years,
a learned man and a great disputant of the Arabs,
by whom and by the multitude of books he composed the Arabs across the whole earth have been and are enlightened today.
For this man may be compared to Origen,
who, though the doctors of the Church grew rich and enlightened from his books,
yet they turned around and called him a heretic.
In like manner also the Arabs
called this man an infidel and an adherent of the Aristotelian doctrine.
And in the year 607
607 of the Arabs [AD 1210],
Muhammad, the son of Hasan, the chief of the Ismailites, died.
He also, like his father, walked in the way of the philosophers,
and utterly demolished and destroyed the foundations of the faith of the Arabs.
In his days, he killed many of the rulers who would not pay him tribute by the hand of his men,
whom he used to send to leap upon the rulers.
And when they killed them,
they themselves would be killed.
